text: A small ball is projected with speed 20 m s at an angle of 45Å above the horizontal from a point O on
horizontal ground. At time t s after projection, the horizontal and vertically upwards displacements
of the ball from O are x m and y m respectively.
A particle P of mass 0.4 kg is attached to one end of a light elastic string of natural length 1.2 m and
modulus of elasticity 19.2 N. The other end of the string is attached to a fixed point A. The particle P
is released from rest at the point 2.7 m vertically above A. Calculate
A uniform object ABC is formed from two rods AB and BC joined rigidly at right angles at B. The
rod AB has length 0.3 m and the rod BC has length 0.2 m. The object rests with the end A on a rough
horizontal surface and the rod AB vertical. The object is held in equilibrium by a horizontal force of
magnitude 4 N applied at B and acting in the direction CB (see diagram).
A particle of mass 0.2 kg is projected vertically downwards with initial speed 4 m s . A resisting
force of magnitude 0.09v N acts vertically upwards on the particle during its descent, where v m s is
the downwards velocity of the particle at time t s after being set in motion.
